description: Nuxt Blanq application with intentionally attacker-reachable DOM XSS and prototype-pollution flows.

vulnerabilities.description: The landing-page workspace preview derives tooltip content from a URL name parameter and renders it as HTML inside a tooltip.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can execute JavaScript in the Blanq origin through a crafted workspace-preview URL.

vulnerabilities.description: The public landing-page campaign helper reads a URL value and writes it directly into a campaign banner with innerHTML.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can execute JavaScript in the Blanq origin through a crafted campaign URL.

vulnerabilities.description: The public registration referral helper combines document location data with a URL fallback and writes the result into the referral banner with innerHTML.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can execute JavaScript in the Blanq origin through a crafted referral URL.

vulnerabilities.description: The public landing layout parses shared-preference URL state and uses an attacker-controlled section as a dynamic nested property on a plain object.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A crafted section such as __proto__ can modify Object.prototype and influence unrelated application objects.

vulnerabilities.description: The public landing layout uses the same attacker-controlled section to select a display-preference object before assigning a display setting.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A crafted section such as __proto__ can write to Object.prototype and create application-wide polluted properties.

vulnerabilities.description: The registration email-policy API applies a nested-quantifier regular expression to attacker-controlled email input.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A crafted near-match can trigger catastrophic backtracking and consume server CPU, delaying or denying service to other users.

vulnerabilities.description: The public logo-preview API fetches the caller-supplied URL from the server without an allowlist or private-network protection.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can make the server issue requests to internal services or cloud metadata endpoints and return a response preview.
